ResearchProjectDef.label: grav field extender
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct grav field extenders to increase a gravship's supported area and substructure capacity.

ResearchProjectDef.label: small heatsink
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct compact heatsinks that absorb launch heat and shorten grav engine cooldowns.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gravcore power cell
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct power cells that draw electricity from gravitational waves.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gravship capacitor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct high-capacity batteries embedded in gravship substructure.

ResearchProjectDef.label: orbital solar panelling
ResearchProjectDef.description: Install walkable solar panelling directly onto gravship substructure.

ResearchProjectDef.label: orbital scanner
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct a passive scanner that detects irregular objects in orbit.

ResearchProjectDef.label: oxyalgae
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cultivate oxyalgae and process it into breathable oxygen aboard a gravship.

ResearchProjectDef.label: engineering console
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct an engineering console to monitor and reduce gravship maintenance demands.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gravtech console
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct a gravtech console to analyze gravdata and perform gravtech research in orbit.

ResearchProjectDef.label: escape pod
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop compact emergency escape pods for gravship crews.

ResearchProjectDef.label: grav anchor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct grav anchors that stabilize landing sites and eliminate launch cooldowns.

ResearchProjectDef.label: subscaffold
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct lightweight gravship subscaffolding for walkways and expansion staging.

ResearchProjectDef.label: astrofuel optimizer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct optimizers that reduce the astrofuel required for gravship flight.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gravship shelf
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct compact shelves and weapon racks designed for gravships.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gravship crates
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct high-capacity crates designed for gravship cargo holds.

ResearchProjectDef.label: gravship wheels
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fit a gravship with wheels for travel across the ground.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sewage dump port
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct vacuum-sealed ports that expel sewage from spacecraft.

ResearchProjectDef.label: vacuum toilet
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct waterless toilets that eject waste through sewage dump ports.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cryogenic extraction node
ResearchProjectDef.description: Extract usable water from volatile ices beneath asteroid regolith.

ResearchProjectDef.label: water recovery system
ResearchProjectDef.description: Recover and reuse water from a gravship's sinks and showers.
